calibrationHistory.change: Normalize hidden-response penalties by completed sample count instead of adding the same risk repeatedly.

measurementNotes: Twelve paired seeds per comparison, swapping policies between seats for 24 games each. This is a pilot sample, not a population-strength estimate.
Beginner, Normal and Hard decisions are unchanged by the final stress-averaging correction; their completed measurements were retained. Expert versus Hard was rerun with the corrected aggregation.
The prior 24-game Expert run remains in calibrationHistory. There are 96 final comparison games and 120 recorded validation games including that calibration run.
Fixed-node deterministic mode ignores wall-clock cutoffs. Timings include observation, planning and validation; some runs overlapped other CPU verification work.
sourceScope: Original 1,102-entry executable registry before card-engine commit 62d8da8. The expanded release has a separate 24-game compatibility sample; do not treat these historical win rates as fresh release measurements.
